title: Beyond Downstream QA: Rethinking How We Evaluate Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.22209v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent memory benchmarks evaluate whether an agent's responses reflect correct knowledge, measuring downstream question-answering accuracy as a proxy for memory quality. We show this evaluation paradigm is incomplete: it conflates memory correctness with retrieval and generation quality, producing both false positives where correct responses mask broken memory and false negatives where incorrect responses blame correct memory for retrieval failures. We introduce FEB-30, a benchmark of 30 fact-evolution trajectories spanning 6 diagnostic categories and 3 difficulty levels, constructed via paradigm inversion: documents are generated from known fact trajectories, yielding deterministic ground truth without human annotation. Each trajectory defines how a fact should evolve across multi-author artifacts (documents, emails, conversations), enabling direct inspection of the memory store after each ingestion step. translated_title: 超越下游问答：重新思考我们如何评估智能体记忆
translated_abstract: 智能体记忆基准通过评估智能体的响应是否反映正确的知识，以下游问答准确率作为记忆质量的代理指标。我们证明这种评估范式是不完整的：它将记忆正确性与检索和生成质量混为一谈，既产生假阳性（正确的响应掩盖了已损坏的记忆），也产生假阴性（错误的响应将检索失败错误地归咎于正确的记忆）。我们提出了FEB-30，这是一个包含30条事实演化轨迹的基准，涵盖6个诊断类别和3个难度级别，通过范式反转的方法构建：文档从已知的事实轨迹生成，从而在无需人工标注的情况下获得确定性的真实标准（ground truth）。每条轨迹定义了一个事实应如何在多作者制品（文档、电子邮件、对话）中演化，从而能够在每次记忆摄取步骤后直接检查记忆存储。
tldr: 本文指出当前以下游问答准确率评估智能体记忆的范式会将记忆正确性与检索、生成质量混淆，并通过范式反转构建了FEB-30基准，可在无人工标注的情况下对智能体记忆存储本身进行确定性的直接评估。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that evaluating agent memory via downstream QA accuracy conflates memory correctness with retrieval and generation quality, and introduces FEB-30, a benchmark built through paradigm inversion that enables deterministic, direct evaluation of the memory store itself without human annotation.
